ui.github.lead: Opens a project folder inside a GitHub repository. Saving sends a commit to GitHub (you can also create a new branch and a pull request). The token and your edits are sent only to GitHub (api.github.com).
ui.github.tokenHint: A fine-grained personal access token. Select only the target repository and set Contents and Pull requests to "Read and write"
ui.github.tokenRemember: Remember the token on this device
ui.github.tokenRememberHint: If not remembered, the token is forgotten when this tab is closed. Do not remember it on a shared device
ui.github.repoInvalid: Enter the repository as owner/repository or as a GitHub URL
ui.github.noPush: This token cannot write to this repository. You can open and edit, but you cannot commit
ui.github.folderHint: The project folder (the folder with masterdata-maker.yaml). Leave empty for the repository root
ui.github.isProject: This folder is a project folder
ui.github.notProject: This folder has no project settings file. Choose one from the list below
ui.github.commitLead: Sends the following changes as one commit on top of branch {branch} of {repo}
ui.github.targetNew: Create a new branch and commit
ui.github.branchInvalid: The branch name contains characters git does not allow (spaces, ~ ^ : ? * [ \, .., and so on)
ui.github.branchExists: Branch {branch} already exists. Choose another name
ui.github.baseSame: Choose a base branch other than the branch you commit to
ui.github.existingPull: Pull request #{number} from this branch is open. The commit will be added to it.
ui.github.donePullExisting: Pull request #{number} from this branch is already open:
ui.github.pullFailed: The commit succeeded, but the pull request could not be created: {message}
ui.github.branchBadgeTitle: Branch {branch} on GitHub is open. Click to switch branches
ui.github.error.unauthorized: The token is invalid or has expired ({message})
ui.github.error.forbidden: The token does not have permission for this operation. Check the token's permissions (Contents and Pull requests: Read and write) and its repositories ({message})
ui.github.error.notFound: Not found. Check the repository, branch and folder names, and that the token covers the repository ({message})
ui.github.error.conflict: GitHub rejected the request. The branch may already exist or may have been updated elsewhere. Commit to a new branch ({message})
ui.github.error.rateLimited: The GitHub API rate limit was reached. Wait a while and try again ({message})
